name: Plott
heading: Plott is a note-taking app for moving ideas around.
body: Think Apple Notes and Obsidian had a baby. Plott has all the tried-and-true formatting tools you’ve come to expect from an app like this.
Toggle on grid mode, though, and a static Markdown note becomes a freeform, multi-column beast. Drag and drop content around the canvas to iterate on ideas quickly for a truly unique experience.

media.alt: Two quarterly goal lists arranged side by side in Plott’s dark editor.
